nary_nodes.label: Salah signs with Trabzonspor
evidence: Mohamed Salah has signed a two-year deal with Trabzonspor, under which the Egypt forward will receive 17 million euros ($19.6 million) a season, the Turkish club said on Thursday.

nary_nodes.label: Signing ceremony in Trabzon
evidence: The announcement came as Trabzon's fans prepared to head for the club's stadium in the eastern Black Sea city for a ceremony to mark the 34-year-old's former Liverpool player's signing on a free transfer the day after a smiling Salah arrived in Istanbul in the team's burgundy and blue kit.

nary_nodes.label: Salah arrives in Istanbul
evidence: the day after a smiling Salah arrived in Istanbul in the team's burgundy and blue kit.

nary_nodes.label: Salah leaves Liverpool
evidence: Salah left Liverpool in the close season after nine years, having scored 257 goals in 442 appearances and having won the Premier League twice and the Champions League.

nary_nodes.label: Salah starts at Basel
evidence: Salah started his career in Europe at Swiss side Basel in 2012 and later joined Chelsea.

nary_nodes.label: Salah at Fiorentina and Roma
evidence: He also had stints at Fiorentina and AS Roma between 2015 and 2017 before joining Liverpool.

nary_nodes.label: Trabzonspor qualifies for Europa League
evidence: Trabzonspor – generally considered to be the fourth-biggest team in Turkey after Istanbul sides Fenerbahce, Galatasaray, and Besiktas – finished third in the Super Lig last season to qualify for the Europa League playoff round.

nary_nodes.label: Salah's salary and bonuses
evidence: The club's statement to the Turkish stock exchange said Salah will receive a 20 percent share from products sold under his name, plus conditional bonuses each season.
The statement did not say how high the bonuses could go and what the bonuses are tied to.

nary_nodes.label: Salah's output waned
evidence: His output waned last season and he was left on the bench in Champions League games, leading to a public spat with Liverpool's then-manager Arne Slot.
